feature_provenance.herb_target_features: 256-dimensional fixed hash projection of HIT herb-target relations
feature_provenance.symptom_features: 256-dimensional fixed hash projection of HIT symptom-gene relations
feature_provenance.drug_target_features: 256-dimensional fixed hash projection of positive DrugBank DTI relations
feature_provenance.excluded: MHGNN pre-generated bipartite herb/symptom embeddings are excluded because they may encode target herb-symptom edges

risk_label_policy.positive: at least one Harmful or Negative evidence record
risk_label_policy.negative: all available evidence records are No Effect
